Session date: 9:18 pm on 26 August, 2022
[D21:1] James: Hey John! Look how cute it is. My dog came to me today while I was playing on the console. What is new?
[D21:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a dog on a couch
[D21:2] John:  Your pup is so cute, remind me what's their name? I've been helping my younger siblings out with programming since they joined the programming course. It's really cool to see them get into it.
[D21:3] James:  His name's Ned and he's been awesome since I adopted him. I can't imagine life without him. It's great to hear that your siblings signed up for programming.
[D21:4] John: That's right, his name is Ned, how could I forget?!
[D21:5] James: Regarding your siblings, are you already working on anything cool with them?
[D21:6] John: Yeah! We're working on a cool project together that involves coding. It's a game and it's helping them learn.
[D21:7] James: Wow, learning and gaming sounds like a fantastic combination for coding education! Can you share more details about the game?
[D21:8] John: Yeah, they're playing a simple, text-based adventure game, working on their coding skills and having fun. I'm so proud of them! Maybe they'll even create their own video games, huh? Any new game designs on your mind?
[D21:9] James: Wow, sounds cool John! Learning coding with a text-based adventure game is impressive stuff. As for me, I've been trying out different genres of games and now I'm dying to create a strategy game like Civilization - love how complicated and in-depth they are. Fingers crossed, one day I'll make my own awesome strategy game!
[D21:10] John: Wow, James, that's impressive! It's gonna be awesome. Can't wait to see what you come up with!
[D21:11] James:  Are you free tomorrow?
[D21:12] John: Yes, tomorrow is my day off. Do you have any suggestions on how to spend tomorrow?
[D21:13] James: Yes, we can go to Starbucks for coffee if you want.
[D21:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a laptop computer with a colorful keyboard on a table
[D21:14] John: I don't mind meeting up, but why Starbucks? Maybe we can have a beer somewhere?
[D21:15] James: Well, how about we go to McGee's pub then? I heard they serve a great stout there!
[D21:16] John: Great idea, except I don't like dark beer. Maybe there's something else there?
[D21:17] James: Of course, there are also light beers!
[D21:18] John: Great, then I agree! See you tomorrow at McGee's Pub!
[D21:19] James: See you John, bye!
Session date: 6:53 pm on 1 September, 2022
[D22:1] James: Hey John! Been a while, but hope you're doing well. My Unity strategy game is finally finished—it took loads of time and effort, but I'm really proud. Your support and encouragement made a real difference. Thanks for believing in me!
[D22:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a screenshot of a stone building with a giant creature
[D22:2] John: Hey James! Congrats on finishing your game! It looks amazing and I'm so proud of you for all the hard work you put in. Can I see more of it? Got any other screenshots to show me?
[D22:3] James: I appreciate your support. Check out this screenshot from it.
[D22:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game screen showing a person on a horse
[D22:4] John: This game looks great! What inspired you to create it?
[D22:5] James: I've always loved playing strategy games like Civilization and Total War, so I decided to challenge myself and create one of my own.
[D22:6] John: That's awesome! I love those games too. It must have been quite an experience making your own. Did you face any difficulties during development?
[D22:7] James: It was a bit challenging to get everything right, balancing mechanics and ensuring fairness. But with some trial and error, I managed to get it to where I wanted it.
[D22:8] John: Wow, that must have been a challenge, especially since you had to make sure the game was enjoyable and balanced. Congratulations on completing it! What were some key takeaways from the experience?
[D22:9] James: Thanks, John! It was definitely a learning experience. Perseverance and patience are key, and I'm proud of what I created after sticking with it. Also, feedback and collaboration are essential, and the help from others really made the game better. It was great!
[D22:10] John: Awesome that you learned those lessons! Collaboration and feedback make a huge impact on any project. I've been teaching my siblings coding. It's been a fulfilling experience and they're already creating their own programs - amazing!
[D22:11] James: Wow, John! Cool seeing others learn with your help. What kind of programs are they making?
[D22:12] John: They're starting small, making basic games and stories. It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having.
[D22:13] James: Wow! It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having. I bet they'll be creating their own complex projects soon!
[D22:14] John: I'm excited to see how far they can go! With their passion for video games like me, hopefully they can use those coding skills to make something cool. I'm so proud of them, can't wait to see what they come up with!
[D22:15] James: I'm proud of them too! Seeing the next generation pick up coding and making their own games is awesome. Can't wait to see what they create!
[D22:16] John: Thanks, James, for the support. I really appreciate it.
[D22:17] James: Yeah, you're the best! I'm here for you, no doubt.
[D22:18] John:  Your friendship really means a lot. I'm going through some difficult times now and it's really good to know I've got someone like you.
[D22:19] James: Just know I'm here if you need someone to talk or vent to. It might help alleviate some of the difficult times you're going through.
